roles.router_fit: same first identity-disjoint calibration half, all nine paired views
roles.safety_selection_and_recalibration: same second calibration half, all nine paired views
roles.final_development_evaluation: tune identities, all nine paired views

states.keep_main: expert has no material advantage and the sample is not ambiguous
states.accept_expert: expert binary log loss plus 0.05 is lower than main binary log loss
states.abstain: non-advantage difficult negative or ambiguous positive near/disagreeing across the fixed target threshold

matched_difficult_negatives.candidate: target-negative and either main or expert probability crosses the frozen main threshold
matched_difficult_negatives.matching: nearest target-negative to each positive accept-expert example, unique union

track_b_recalibrated.method: separately calibrate base and selected final target thresholds to FPR cap 0.10; keep non-target thresholds frozen

overall_gate: both mechanism and deployment promotion must pass before P2
required_outputs: per-sample three-state probabilities and final probabilities
